name: spatial correlation
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
usage_note: 用于轨道参数等其他随机场时仍需核对对象。不得把 correlation、correlation coefficient 和 covariance 混作同一量。

complete_examples.text: Then, the fluctuating cross winds are simulated by the fast Fourier transform technique from spectral representations with the consideration of spatial correlation of multipoint wind time histories and vehicle movement.
Due to the random-ness, spatial correlation, and time-varying characteristics of fluctuating winds, it is inevitably a key and complex task to characterize the nature of wind turbulence.
Ignoring the spatial correlation of random variables might underestimate the performance of the track system.
Besides, the case without considering the spatial correlation of parameter and cov is 0.3 (C4) is carried out as a comparison.
The fluctuating winds are simulated using the modified spectral representation method with consideration of the spatial correlation of the fluctuating winds.
